'''White seedcake''' was a type of [[Cake/Legends|cake]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]]. The Ortolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] excitedly anticipated having the cake for [[Foodstuff/Legends|dinner]] one [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="ATBPO" /> around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">[[Color/Legends|White]] [[Cake/Legends|cake's]] mention in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" takes place a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the part of the story that is concurrent with {{Film|VI}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> However, he got neither the dinner nor [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Seed/Legends|seedcake]] he desired that night.<ref name="ATBPO" />

==Behind the scenes==
White seedcake was mentioned in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="ATBPO" />
